column_description: BIGINT. Unique security-profile identifier. PK.
TEXT. Associated data-flow identifier. FK to DataFlow.
BIGINT. Linked risk-management identifier. FK to RiskManagement.
BIGINT. Linked data-profile identifier. FK to DataProfile.
TEXT. Record registry reference string. Example: CB932064.
TEXT. Overall encryption state descriptor. Possible values: Full, Partial.
TEXT. Encryption method applied. **NULL means encryption method not specified.**. Possible values: AES-256, Custom, RSA-2048, SM4. Possible values: AES-256, Custom, RSA-2048, SM4.
TEXT. Key-management state descriptor. **NULL means key management state not recorded.**. Possible values: Centralized, Distributed, Hybrid. Possible values: Centralized, Distributed, Hybrid.
TEXT. Data-masking level applied. **NULL means masking level not specified.**. Possible values: Full, Partial. Possible values: Full, Partial.
TEXT. Anonymisation method employed. Possible values: K-Anonymity, L-Diversity, T-Closeness. Possible values: K-Anonymity, L-Diversity, T-Closeness.
TEXT. Pseudonymisation state. **NULL means pseudonymisation not applied.**. Possible values: Applied, Partial. Possible values: Applied, Partial.
TEXT. Authentication method used. Possible values: Basic, MFA, SSO. Possible values: Basic, MFA, SSO.
TEXT. Authorisation framework employed. Possible values: ABAC, Custom, RBAC. Possible values: ABAC, Custom, RBAC.
TEXT. Access-control-list state descriptor. Possible values: Adequate, Strong, Weak. Possible values: Adequate, Strong, Weak.
TEXT. API security state descriptor. **NULL means API security not assessed.**. Possible values: Review Required, Secure, Vulnerable. Possible values: Review Required, Secure, Vulnerable.
TEXT. Logging integrity-check status. Possible values: Failed, Passed, Pending. Possible values: Failed, Passed, Pending.
BIGINT. Log-retention period in days. Example: 905. Example: 905.
TEXT. Backup state descriptor. **NULL means backup state not documented.**. Possible values: Current, Failed, Outdated. Possible values: Current, Failed, Outdated.
TEXT. Data-recovery state descriptor. Possible values: Missing, Tested, Untested. Possible values: Missing, Tested, Untested.
TEXT. Business-continuity or blockchain state descriptor. Possible values: Active, Outdated, Review Required. Possible values: Active, Outdated, Review Required.
